meta.name: pinme-auth
meta.description: Use when a PinMe project (Worker TypeScript) needs to integrate user authentication — creating email/password users, verifying id_tokens, querying user info, or listing users via Identity Platform auth proxy APIs.

copy.tagline: 为 PinMe 项目集成用户认证功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在开发需要用户认证的 PinMe 项目
copy.tagline_en: Integrate user authentication into your PinMe project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building a PinMe project that needs user authentication

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你调用 PinMe 平台的用户认证接口，包括创建邮箱密码用户、校验登录令牌、查询单个用户信息、分页列出所有用户。
howto.when: 当你在 PinMe Worker 项目中需要集成用户认证功能时触发，例如注册、登录、查看用户列表等场景。

say.text: 校验这个 id_token 是否有效。
say.note: Claude 会调用校验令牌接口，返回 uid 和邮箱。

say.text: 列出项目中的所有用户，每页 100 个。
say.note: Claude 会调用列出用户接口，返回用户列表和翻页令牌。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can call PinMe platform's auth proxy APIs to create email/password users, verify id_tokens, query user info, and list users with pagination.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a PinMe Worker project needs to integrate user authentication, such as user registration, login, or user listing.

say_en.text: Create a new user with email alice@example.com and password Test@12345678.
say_en.note: Claude will call the create user API and return user info.
Claude will call the verify token API and return uid and email.

say_en.text: List all users in the project, 100 per page.
say_en.note: Claude will call the list users API and return user list and next page token.
